Photo 2 shows the machine from a side angle with the lid open, showing the same beige/grey finish and dust on the glass.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal mechanical or electrical faults.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner and drum status screen or a recent replacement receipt.
Close-up of any labels, stickers or metal plates showing the brand and model.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
